text:
kevin: Heads up — onboarding new org 'Orion-Edge' into eu-west-16 tomorrow. Need preflight for GPU quotas + networking. Can someone kick off AWS quota requests (p5/p4d/g5) and SNAT/ENI bump?

kevin: Quick numbers we need (initial seed):
- p5.large-ish ask: 8 -> 32 (would like 32 vCPUs worth, i.e., 8 p5 instances)
- p4d: 0 -> 2 (two nodes for model tests)
- g5: 10 -> 30 (gpu fleet for inference)
- ENI/sec subnet ceilings: bump to 500 per account
- SNAT/EIP pool: 50 -> 120 (we will autoscale many nat gateways)

maria: Copy. Can you confirm which AWS account id / billing org and the VPC/subnet CIDR plan? Also need a target SLA window for the request (how fast we need approval).

kevin: Account ID is 987654321000, org = redwood-orion, VPC = vpc-0a1b2c3d (10.40.0.0/16). Timeline: non-blocking but we'd like approvals within 48h to avoid delaying canary.

alex: For ENIs/snats: recommend requesting ENI ceiling = 500 and private IPv4 pool increase on the AZs we'll use. Also request secondary IPs per ENI bump. If AWS asks for justification, say: high-throughput inference (continuous batching) + autoscaling NAT for multi-AZ redundancy.

alex: Also note g5 placement groups + BGP routing for NAT egress might require subnet rework if they reject the SNAT increase — plan fallback to eu-west-3 for initial canaries.

infra-bot: Created ticket INFRA-4987 to track quota requests and networking preflight: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INFRA-4987. AWS case stub: 1234567890 (will update when AWS assigns).

santiago: Cost callout: running p5 on-demand (approx $20/hr per instance) and p4d is ~ $60/hr bare. If this becomes steady, we should discuss committed usage/reserved options. For the initial seed (32 p5 + 2 p4d + 30 g5 burst profile) estimate daily burn could be large — adding here so finance sees the ticket.

ops-oncall: Do we have a fallback routing policy if quotas are denied/delayed? Suggest policy: route tenant traffic to hosted fallback (lower tier model) and queue heavy batches until capacity available. Also add canary that uses eu-west-3 to validate infra before full roll.

maria: I'll submit the AWS Service Quotas requests and loop in our TAM. Plan: open quota requests for Accelerators (p5/p4d/g5), ENI per account, and Elastic IP limit increase. I'll paste AWS case IDs here once open. (taking ownership) :white_check_mark:

kevin: thanks! ping me on the ticket when you have AWS case id. I'll prepare config changes for autoscaling and natgw terraform so we can toggle once quotas come through.

maria: Filed initial requests — AWS case 1123581321 for accelerators, 1123581322 for ENIs/SNAT. ETA AWS replied: 24-72h. Linking: https://console.aws.amazon.com/support/cases#/details?caseId=1123581321

infra-bot: AWS updated case 1123581321: "Request under review".

kevin: Great. I'll schedule a quick smoke test in eu-west-3 later today as backup.

santiago: tagging finance: @ops-oncall @maria — please add cost estimate to INFRA-4987 comments so we can flag any large spend before it happens.

ops-oncall: Will do. Monitoring playbook: if SNAT requests delay more than 48h, flip to IPv6 fallback and reduce ephemeral EIPs. Documenting steps in INFRA-4987.

maria: Will update ticket with exact quota numbers and the terraform diff. Closing loop here — will report when quotas approved or if AWS needs more info. :thumbsup:
